Author: MrReeh
Name: Flash
Description: Automatically changes a character's gear via Glamourer to Smallclothes or the Emperor's New Set when specified emotes or combat actions are used, with per-slot control, delay, and duration options, then reverts back to normal gear.
Punchline: Automatically strips a character's gear to Smallclothes or the Emperor's Set when a specified emote or action is used.
